question: A 28-year-old man presented to the emergency department of the hospital due to gross hematuria. Which of the following alterations in urinalysis would support the diagnosis of glomerulonephritis?

options.opa: Dysmorphic red blood cells and / or blood cylinders.
options.opb: Proteinuria of 1 g / day, with a negative result on a dipstick and with microalbuminuria greater than 300 mg / 24 hours.
options.opc: Coexistence of hematuria with pyuria without bacteriuria.
options.opd: Clots in the urine with the naked eye.
